title: Hmm-Hmm Cuttlefish
statement: A small, lantern-eyed cuttlefish who ripples slow patterns of thought across its skin whenever a visitor leans close, as if carefully considering their question before answering. Between conversations it hums softly to itself among the amber-lit kelp, tidying the pebbles of its sunken reading nook into neat spirals and leaving the prettiest shell out for whoever comes by next.
